sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，每晚你都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，你把DJ台

sentences.en: Today, Senate Republicans can afford to lose just two votes as the health care bill heads toward a vote this week.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着医保法案本周即将付诸表决，参议院共和党人仅能承受两票的反对。

sentences.en: That means President Trump's promise to repeal Obamacare could come down to one issue, abortion.
sentences.zh: 这意味着特朗普总统废除奥巴马医改的承诺可能归结为一个问题：堕胎。

sentences.en: And they say he's speaking for the dead, how the families of people killed by immigrants without legal status have become the emotional cornerstone
sentences.zh: 他们说他是在为死者发声：那些被无合法身份的移民杀害的人的家属，是如何成为情感基石的

sentences.en: of another of President Trump's signature issues.
sentences.zh: 这也是特朗普总统另一个标志性议题的核心。

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月26日，星期一。

sentences.en: Cheryl Gay Stolberg, what's threatening the passage of the Senate health care bill this week?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔贝格，是什么在威胁着参议院医保法案本周的通过？
zh_words: 谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔贝格

sentences.en: Well, one of the biggest threats has to do with abortion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最大的威胁之一与堕胎有关。

sentences.en: Two provisions.
sentences.zh: 两项条款。

sentences.en: First, the Senate bill would defund Planned Parenthood for a year, and it would also bar the use of federal tax credits
sentences.zh: 首先，参议院的法案将在一年内取消对“计划生育”组织的联邦拨款，同时它还将禁止使用联邦税收抵免

sentences.en: to help purchase insurance plans that include abortion coverage.
sentences.zh: 来帮助购买包含堕胎保障的保险计划。

sentences.en: And that has proven to be a real sticking point, especially with two of the female Republican senators,
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这成了一个真正的症结所在，尤其是对于两位女性共和党参议员来说，

sentences.en: Susan Collins of Maine and Lisa Murkowski of Alaska.
sentences.zh: 来自缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯和来自阿拉斯加州的莉萨·穆尔科斯基。

sentences.en: I will not vote to deny Alaskans access to the health services that Planned Parenthood provides.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会投票剥夺阿拉斯加人获得“计划生育”组织所提供的医疗服务的权利。

sentences.en: It makes absolutely no sense to eliminate federal funding for Planned Parenthood.
sentences.zh: 取消对“计划生育”组织的联邦资助完全没有任何道理。

sentences.en: Is it any coincidence, Cheryl, that the two Republican senators we're hearing from who have strong misgivings about taking money away from Planned Parenthood,
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，我们听到这两位共和党女参议员对撤回“计划生育”组织的资金表现出强烈的疑虑，这难道是巧合吗？

sentences.en: that they're both women?
sentences.zh: 她们俩都是女性？

sentences.en: It is absolutely no coincidence at all, in my view, that they're both women.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，她们俩都是女性绝对不是巧合。

sentences.en: This is something that really hits at women's own experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一个真正触及女性自身经历的问题。

sentences.en: So, in my view, it's not at all surprising that the biggest roadblocks to this provision lie with Susan Collins and Lisa Murkowski.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我看来，这一条款的最大阻力来自苏珊·柯林斯和莉萨·穆尔科斯基，一点也不令人意外。

sentences.en: And Planned Parenthood is an important provider of health care services, including family planning and cancer screenings for millions of Americans, particularly women.
sentences.zh: “计划生育”组织是医疗保健服务的重要提供者，包括为数百万美国人，尤其是女性，提供计划生育和癌症筛查。

sentences.en: And they should be allowed to choose the health provider that they want.
sentences.zh: 他们应该有权选择自己想要的医疗服务提供者。

sentences.en: How does abortion fit into the much larger American health care system?
sentences.zh: 堕胎是如何融入庞大的美国医疗体系的？

sentences.en: There's Medicaid on the table.
sentences.zh: 摆在台面上有医疗白卡。

sentences.en: There's insurance coverage broadly.
sentences.zh: 还有广泛的保险覆盖。

sentences.en: There are pre-existing conditions.
sentences.zh: 还有既往病史。

sentences.en: I mean, where does abortion fit into that landscape?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，堕胎在这个大局中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: Well, abortion is actually a very small part of that landscape.
sentences.zh: 嗯，堕胎其实只是这个大局中的一小部分。

sentences.en: And it's also a very small part of what Planned Parenthood does.
sentences.zh: 它也只是“计划生育”组织工作的一小部分。

sentences.en: So, in that sense, I guess you're right.
sentences.zh: 所以，从这个意义上说，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: It is seemingly a side issue, but a very politically divisive side issue.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一个次要问题，但却是一个政治上极具分歧的次要问题。

sentences.en: And it's an issue that is an attention grabber.
sentences.zh: 这是一个引人注目的问题。

sentences.en: It's a headline grabber.
sentences.zh: 这是一个能上头条的问题。

sentences.en: It's something that both sides can sum up in a soundbite, whereas the larger health care bill is maybe a confusing picture.
sentences.zh: 这是双方可以用一句简短口号概括的事，而庞大的医保法案或许是一幅令人困惑的画面。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And can we back up a little bit?
sentences.zh: 我们能稍微回顾一下吗？

sentences.en: And can you just tell us what exactly does the Senate bill propose to do to Planned Parenthood?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们，参议院的法案到底提议对“计划生育”组织做些什么吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, the Senate bill would cut off funding for Planned Parenthood.
sentences.zh: 参议院的法案将切断对“计划生育”组织的资金支持。

sentences.en: And Planned Parenthood gets about $550 million a year in federal funding.
sentences.zh: “计划生育”组织每年获得约5.5亿美元的联邦资助。

sentences.en: And the bill would cut it off, although only for just one year.
sentences.zh: 该法案将切断这笔资金，尽管只维持短短一年。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And that's kind of a very interesting note.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个非常有趣的点。

sentences.en: The bill would cut off funding for only one year, in fact, because it would be very expensive to cut off funding for more than that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，法案只切断了一年的资金，因为切断更长时间的资金成本会非常高昂。

sentences.en: The Congressional Budget Office has noted that cutting off funding for Planned Parenthood longer
sentences.zh: 国会预算办公室指出，切断对“计划生育”组织的资助超过

sentences.en: than a year would actually increase federal spending on health care because so many women who were using Planned Parenthood to get birth control would not get birth control,
sentences.zh: 一年实际上会增加联邦在医疗保健上的支出，因为许多利用“计划生育”组织获得避孕药具的女性将无法获得避孕药具，

sentences.en: and therefore, more babies would be born, and those babies would be covered by Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 因此，会有更多婴儿出生，而这些婴儿将由医疗白卡覆盖。

sentences.en: So, this clearly is not about saving money.
sentences.zh: 所以，这显然不是为了省钱。

sentences.en: No, this is clearly an ideological fight.
sentences.zh: 不，这显然是一场意识形态斗争。

sentences.en: Now, the fight in front of us feels like a climax of a really long-fought battle between pro-abortion and anti-abortion groups.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们眼前的这场斗争让人感觉像是亲堕胎和反堕胎团体之间长期激烈斗争的高潮。

sentences.en: Talk a little bit about what led up to this really high-stakes moment in front of us.
sentences.zh: 请谈谈是什么导致了我们眼前这个赌注极高的时刻。

sentences.en: Well, it's been building for years, but especially hit a crescendo during the election.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这已经酝酿多年了，但在选举期间尤其达到了高潮。

sentences.en: I am pro-life.
sentences.zh: 我是反堕胎的。

sentences.en: I had an experience with a friend of mine who was, frankly, they were going to abort their child,
sentences.zh: 我曾经历过我的一位朋友，坦白说，他们曾打算对孩子实施堕胎，

sentences.en: which they ended up having, and their child is like this magnificent person, and it had an impact.
sentences.zh: 但他们最终生了下来，他们的孩子就像一个杰出的人，这产生了影响。

sentences.en: When Donald Trump was running for president, he signed a letter, a commitment, that he would satisfy anti-abortion advocates for demands.
sentences.zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普竞选总统时，他签署了一封信、一份承诺书，表示他将满足反堕胎倡导者的要求。

sentences.en: Among those demands was appointing a Supreme Court justice who would overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 这些要求包括任命一位将推翻“罗伊诉韦德案”的最高法院大法官，

sentences.en: Wade, and another of those demands was to defund Planned Parenthood.
sentences.zh: 另一项要求是取消对“计划生育”组织的拨款。

sentences.en: And, in fact, Marjorie Dannenfelser, who heads the Susan B.
sentences.zh: 事实上，领导反堕胎团体“苏珊·B·安东尼名单”的马乔里·丹宁费尔塞告诉我，那是

sentences.en: Anthony list, which is an anti-abortion group, told me that that was the most valuable piece of paper
sentences.zh: 她的组织收到的最宝贵的一张纸，即特朗普总统写下的那份承诺。

sentences.en: her organization has ever received, that commitment that President Trump wrote.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，这是他们切断一个他们认为是邪恶的组织的资金的机会。

sentences.en: And she's told me that this was their chance to defund an organization, she said, that we think is evil.
sentences.zh: 正是出于这种程度，这是他们一直在极力推动的事情，他们不会轻易让它溜走。

sentences.en: It's at that level that this is something that they've been pushing for and pushing for, and they're not going to let it slip away so easily.
sentences.zh: 现在，仅仅切断一年的“计划生育”组织资助，表面上看似乎算不上巨大的胜利，但它在象征意义或其他方面算是一场巨大胜利吗？

sentences.en: And now defunding Planned Parenthood for a single year, though, it doesn't feel on its face like a massive victory, but is it a massive victory symbolically or otherwise?
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 不过，比起象征性的胜利，它对“计划生育”组织来说实际上将是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: And more so than a symbolic victory, though, it would really be a devastating hit for Planned Parenthood.
sentences.zh: 联邦资助占“计划生育”组织预算的大约41%。

sentences.en: Federal funding accounts for roughly 41% of Planned Parenthood's budget.
sentences.zh: 如果这通过了，全国各地的“计划生育”诊所将会关闭。

sentences.en: If this goes through, Planned Parenthood clinics around the country will close.
sentences.zh: “计划生育”组织在全国拥有大约600家诊所。

sentences.en: Planned Parenthood has about 600 clinics around the country.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 我们有一份指南，展示了这在各州会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We have a guide of what this would look like in the States.
sentences.zh: 在得克萨斯州，得州试图切断对“计划生育”组织以及提供堕胎服务的诊所的资金支持，其大约30%的计划生育诊所关闭了。

sentences.en: In Texas, Texas sought to cut off funding for Planned Parenthood and for clinics that provide abortion, and some 30% of its family planning clinics closed.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对会看到贫困女性无法获得她们从“计划生育”组织获得的的基本医疗护理。

sentences.en: We would absolutely see poor women going without basic medical care that they get from Planned Parenthood.
sentences.zh: 她们可能无法获得避孕药具，并且可能会生下更多孩子。

sentences.en: They would probably be going without birth control, and they might be having more babies.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢丽尔，非常感谢你接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Okay, Cheryl, thanks so much for talking with us.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，凯特琳。

sentences.en: Okay, thank you, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 这个周末，参议院共和党人正赶着锁定对医保法案的支持，

sentences.en: This weekend, Senate Republicans were rushing to lock down support for the health care bill,
sentences.zh: 试图在周末休会前赢得本党成员的支持。

sentences.en: trying to win over members of their own party before they go on recess at the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能在下周对这个进行投票。

sentences.en: There's no way we should be voting on this next week.
sentences.zh: 我很难相信威斯康星州的选民，甚至连我自己，会有足够的时间来正确评估这一点，从而让我投票赞成推进动议。

sentences.en: I have a hard time believing Wisconsin constituents or even myself will have enough time to properly evaluate this for me to vote for a motion to proceed.
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔和其他参议院领导人正在起草修正案并进行交易，

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell and other Senate leaders are drafting amendments and cutting deals
sentences.zh: 以安抚越来越多表示要么无法支持现行医保法案、要么心存疑虑的共和党参议员。

sentences.en: to appease the growing number of Republican senators who have said they either cannot support the health care bill as drafted or have misgivings.
sentences.zh: 周日，特朗普总统在福克斯新闻上表达了他对法案将获得通过的信心。

sentences.en: On Sunday, President Trump went on Fox News to express his confidence that the bill will pass.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健是一件非常非常难办成的事，但我认为我们会办成的。

sentences.en: Health care is a very, very tough thing to get, but I think we're going to get it.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有太多选择，因为替代方案是奥巴马医改那具死尸。

sentences.en: But we don't have too much of a choice because the alternative is the dead carcass of Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 事实就是这样。

sentences.en: That's what it is.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我叫史蒂夫·龙讷贝克。

sentences.zh: 我住在亚利桑那州梅萨。

sentences.en: I live in Mesa, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子于2015年1月22日被一名非法移民罪犯杀害。

sentences.en: My son was killed by an illegal immigrant criminal January 22nd, 2015.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫阿波利纳尔·阿尔塔米拉诺的人在早上3点30分、将近4点左右走进了格兰特工作的快急便利店，把一罐零钱倒在柜台上，
zh_words: 阿波利纳尔·阿尔塔米拉诺

sentences.en: A man by the name of Apollinar Altamirano went into the quick trip where Grant was working at about 3.30, quarter to 4 in the morning, dumped a jar of change out on the counter,
sentences.zh: 想要买烟。

sentences.en: and wanted to buy cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 格兰特开始数零钱，阿尔塔米拉诺说，怎么，你不打算把烟给我吗？

sentences.en: Grant started to count the change, and Altamirano said, what, you're not going to give me my cigarettes?
sentences.zh: 格兰特试图向他解释他必须把零钱数清楚。

sentences.en: And Grant tried to explain to him that he had to count the change.
sentences.zh: 阿尔塔米拉诺随后掏出一把枪，指着格兰特。

sentences.en: Altamirano then produced a gun, pointed it at Grant.
sentences.zh: 格兰特立即把烟交给了他，而阿尔塔米拉诺处决了他，对着他的脸近距离开枪。

sentences.en: Grant immediately gave him the cigarettes, and Altamirano executed him, shot him point-blank in the face.
sentences.zh: 你是怎么发现格兰特出事的？

sentences.en: How did you find out what happened to Grant?
sentences.zh: 梅萨警察局派了几名侦探到家里来，他们告诉我说他们已经抓到了凶手，而且他是个非法移民。

sentences.en: Mesa Police Department had sent some detectives over to the house, and they had told me that they had caught the person and that he was an illegal.
sentences.zh: 他此前曾因入室抢劫被捕，对他们闯入的那名女性进行了性侵犯，

sentences.en: He had been previously arrested for doing a home invasion, sexually assaulting the woman's
sentences.zh: 但他能够通过认罪协商将罪名降为二级入室盗窃，他刚刚完成缓刑。

sentences.en: house that they had broken into, that he had been able to plead it down to just second-degree burglary, that he had just gotten done with probation.
sentences.zh: 然后他们讲述了细节，他们是如何逮捕他的。

sentences.en: Then they went into the details, how they arrested him.
sentences.zh: 他有一百万美元的现金保释金，诸如此类。

sentences.en: He's on a million dollars cash bond, so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，在格兰特去世后，你决定做些什么？

sentences.en: Steve, what did you decide to do after Grant's death?
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一段时间，这只是一天天地努力维持正常生活。

sentences.en: Well, for a while, it was just a matter of just trying to function every day.
sentences.zh: 然后我的弟弟代替我前往国会，并在关于非法移民的参议院听证会上作证。

sentences.en: And then my brother had stood in for me and went and testified in front of Congress and in front of
sentences.zh: 这是我家人的最大愿望，即格兰特·龙讷贝克的遗产不仅仅是一份日渐模糊的讣告、一块墓地或一段美好的回忆。

sentences.en: Senate hearings on illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们希望格兰特的死成为推动这个伟大国家移民政策变革和改革的力量。

sentences.en: It is my family's greatest desire that Grant Ronebeck's legacy will be more than a fading obituary, a cemetery plot, or a fond memory.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他回来后说，嘿，下次轮到你了。

sentences.en: Instead, we want Grant's death to be a force for change and reform in the immigration policies of this great nation.
sentences.zh: 所以大约在这个时候，新闻媒体和，你知道的，我们的一些地方政治人物开始介入此事。

sentences.en: You know, he came back and he said, hey, it's your turn next time.
sentences.zh: 除了为工作而来的移民之外，还有其他人是为了犯罪目的而来的。

sentences.en: So it was about that time that the news media and, you know, a few of our local politicians were getting involved in it.
sentences.zh: 而他们放了他们，放了他们，又放了他们，然后将他们驱逐出境。

sentences.en: And along with the immigrants that are coming for work, there are others that are coming for criminal reasons.
sentences.zh: 然后他们马上回来并犯下其他罪行。

sentences.en: And they let them go and they let them go and they let them go and deport them.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我决定是时候抗争了。

sentences.en: And then they come right back and commit other crimes.
sentences.zh: 是时候结束这种毫无意义的行径了。

sentences.en: And that's when I just decided it was time to fight.
sentences.zh: 首先，阿尔塔米拉诺本该被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: It was time to put an end to the senselessness.
sentences.zh: 其次是如果对他进行正确的指控，格兰特现在还活着。

sentences.en: Altamirano should have been deported, number one.
sentences.zh: 你究竟开始为什么而战？

sentences.en: Number two is if he had been charged correctly, Grant would still be alive.
sentences.zh: 你抓住的事业是什么？

sentences.en: What exactly was it that you began to fight for?
sentences.zh: 基本上是驱逐这些非法移民罪犯。

sentences.en: What was the cause that you latched onto?
sentences.zh: 请不要曲解我的意思。

sentences.en: Basically, deportation of these illegal immigrant criminals.
sentences.zh: 我不是指非法移民。

sentences.en: And please don't twist it around.
sentences.zh: 我说的是非法移民罪犯，那些被定罪的人，那些以前被驱逐出境却不断回来的人。

sentences.en: I'm not saying illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 不管他们是西班牙裔、危地马拉人、俄罗斯人还是中国人，这都无所谓。

sentences.en: I'm saying illegal immigrant criminals, the ones that have been convicted, the ones that have been deported before that keep coming back.
sentences.zh: 这不重要。

sentences.en: And it doesn't matter if they're Hispanic or if they're Guatemalan or if they're Russian or if they're Chinese.
sentences.zh: 如果他们非法留在这里并且犯罪，就不应该被允许留在我们的国家。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，考虑到有研究表明移民中的犯罪率并不比普通人群更高，为什么这让你觉得是一项正确的正义事业？

sentences.en: If they're here illegally and they commit a crime, they shouldn't be allowed to stay in our country.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，为什么这个目标不是枪支管控或其他犯罪减少策略。

sentences.en: Why did this feel like the right cause for you, Steve, given there's research that shows criminality isn't any more common among immigrants than it is among the general population?
sentences.zh: 首先要说明的是，杀死格兰特的不是枪。

sentences.en: I just wonder why the cause wasn't gun control or some other crime mitigation tactic.
sentences.zh: 是枪后面的人杀死了格兰特。

sentences.en: First things first, the gun didn't kill Grant.
sentences.zh: 这些死亡都是可以预防的。

sentences.en: The man behind the gun killed Grant.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所抓住的事情。

sentences.en: These deaths are all preventable.
sentences.zh: 这就是你所提出的问题的答案：这些死亡是可以预防的。

sentences.en: And that's the thing that I latched onto.
sentences.zh: 如果那些以前犯过罪的非法移民被驱逐出境，而无法返回我们的国家呢？

sentences.en: And that's the answer to the question that you had asked is these deaths are preventable.
sentences.zh: 如果有过移民犯罪前科，曾经被驱逐出境却没有再回到我们国家？

sentences.en: Had these illegal immigrants that committed the crimes before, had they been deported and not been able to come back into our country?
sentences.zh: 这些曾犯下罪行的非法移民，当时是否被驱逐出境且无法再返回我国？

sentences.en: These deaths are completely preventable.
sentences.zh: 这些死亡是完全可以避免的。

sentences.en: And it's all just a matter of enforcing the laws that we have and securing our border.
sentences.zh: 这一切只是执行我们现有的法律和保卫我们边境的问题。

sentences.en: Did you feel like you were being heard?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你的声音被听到了吗？

sentences.en: Were you having any success?
sentences.zh: 你取得了一些成功吗？

sentences.en: To a certain extent, yes.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，是的。

sentences.en: I was having some success.
sentences.zh: 我确实取得了一些成功。

sentences.en: But it wasn't out there.
sentences.zh: 但这并不引人注目。

sentences.en: It wasn't this huge, huge issue until Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 直到唐纳德·特朗普出现，这都不是一个如此巨大、极其重要的问题。

sentences.en: They are being released by the tens of thousands into our communities with no regard for the impact on public safety or resources.
sentences.zh: 他们正以数以万计的规模被释放到我们的社区中，完全不顾对公共安全或资源的影响。

sentences.en: I wasn't real sure of President Trump when he first jumped into the campaign.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统刚开始参加竞选时，我并不是真的很确定他。

sentences.en: I had actually endorsed Senator Cruz firSt.
sentences.zh: 我其实最初支持的是克鲁斯参议员。

sentences.en: And why were you skeptical of the president?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么对总统持怀疑态度呢？

sentences.en: You know, the only thing that made me skeptical, and this is literally the only thing that I was
sentences.zh: 你知道，唯一让我感到怀疑的，而且真的是我唯一

sentences.en: skeptical about, was his Twitter, him tweeting at two or three in the morning and all these tweets that were coming out.
sentences.zh: 感到怀疑的事情，就是他的推特，他在两三点发推，还有所有这些冒出来的推文。

sentences.en: It just didn't seem normal.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很不正常。

sentences.en: So what changed with Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 那么唐纳德·特朗普有什么改变呢？

sentences.en: And you said initially you supported Senator Cruz.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说你最初支持克鲁斯参议员。

sentences.en: So, you know, what was he doing differently?
sentences.zh: 那么，你知道，他有什么不同的做法吗？

sentences.en: What was it that spoke to you about his message?
sentences.zh: 他的什么信息触动了你？

sentences.en: Well, Senator Cruz had dropped out of the race.
sentences.zh: 嗯，克鲁斯参议员已经退出了竞选。

sentences.en: And at that point, I figured, OK, I'm done.
sentences.zh: 在那个时候，我想，好吧，我完了。

sentences.en: And then the Trump campaign had contacted me and asked me if I would speak at one of Trump's rallies.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普竞选团队联系了我，问我是否愿意在特朗普的一个集会上演讲。

sentences.en: And I was like, sure, no problem.
sentences.zh: 我说，当然，没问题。

sentences.en: He brought in a lot of people who happened to have lost loved ones to accidents or shootings that involved unauthorized immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他带来了许多人，他们的亲人恰好死于涉及无证移民的事故或枪击事件。

sentences.en: Vivian Yee covers immigration for The Times.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安·陈为《泰晤士报》报道移民新闻。

sentences.en: In some ways, these people are immune to political criticism, because what can you really say to someone who has lost their child in a tragedy?
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这些人对政治批评是免疫的，因为你对一个在悲剧中失去了孩子的人究竟能说些什么呢？

sentences.en: Name your child and come right by.
sentences.zh: 请说出你孩子的名字并走过来。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请吧。

sentences.en: Laura Wilkerson and my son was Joshua Wilkerson.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·威尔克森，我的儿子是约书亚·威尔克森。

sentences.en: He was murdered by an illegal in 2010.
sentences.zh: 他在2010年被一名非法移民谋杀。

sentences.en: And I personally support Mr. Trump for our next president.
sentences.zh: 我个人支持特朗普先生成为我们的下一任总统。

sentences.en: And they really became these incredibly powerful voices for him on the campaign trail, because
sentences.zh: 他们在竞选活动中真正成为了他极其有力的代言人，因为

sentences.en: they could really speak from the deepest kind of part of human experience about how this issue had affected them.
sentences.zh: 他们能够从人类最深处的经验出发，讲述这个问题是如何影响他们的。

sentences.en: And so, you know, in some of these rallies, you could hear a pin drop.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在其中一些集会上，你会听到一根针掉地上的声音。

sentences.en: I'm Steve Ronebeck, father of Grant Ronebeck, 21 years old, killed January 22, 2015 by an illegal immigrant who shot him in the face.
sentences.zh: 我是史蒂夫·罗内贝克，格兰特·罗内贝克的父亲，21岁，于2015年1月22日被一名朝他面部开枪的非法移民杀害。

sentences.en: I truly believe that Mr. Trump is going to change things.
sentences.zh: 我坚信特朗普先生会改变现状。

sentences.en: He's going to fight for my family, and he's going to fight for America.
sentences.zh: 他会为我的家庭而战，他会为美国而战。

sentences.en: In just a little story, I can remember one of his staffers had come and said, hey, it's time for you to go up on stage.
sentences.zh: 简单讲个小故事，我记得他的一个工作人员走过来说，嘿，该你上台了。

sentences.en: We need you to get up on stage.
sentences.zh: 我们需要你上台。

sentences.en: And the president turned to him and he says, I'm not done.
sentences.zh: 总统转过身对他说，我还没讲完。

sentences.en: I'm talking to these people.
sentences.zh: 我在跟这些人说话。

sentences.en: They can wait.
sentences.zh: 他们可以等。

sentences.en: He actually put his rally on hold for about 10 minutes so that he could talk to us.
sentences.zh: 他实际上把集会暂停了大约10分钟，以便与我们交谈。

sentences.en: And what did you think about what he said that day?
sentences.zh: 你对那天他所说的话有什么看法？

sentences.en: That was a really controversial speech.
sentences.zh: 那是一场非常具争议的演讲。

sentences.en: President Obama and Hillary Clinton engrossed dereliction of duty by surrendering the safety of the American people to open borders.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统和希拉里·克林顿通过将美国人民的安全拱手让给开放边境，犯下了玩忽职守的罪行。

sentences.en: And you know it better than anybody right here in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 你们比亚利桑那州的任何人都要清楚这一点。

sentences.en: You know it.
sentences.zh: 你们知道的。

sentences.en: I agreed with it.
sentences.zh: 我对此表示赞同。

sentences.en: I can remember being there with Marianne Mendoza, the mother of Sergeant Brandon Mendoza,
sentences.zh: 我记得和玛丽安·门多萨在一起，她是布兰登·门多萨警长的母亲，

sentences.en: the Mace police officer who was killed by the wrong way driver that was an illegal immigrant.
sentences.zh: 那个被逆行驾驶的非法移民杀害的梅萨警察局警官。

sentences.en: And just looking at her and her looking at me, and we're just in awe that somebody is actually hearing.
sentences.zh: 看着她，她看着我，我们都惊叹于居然真的有人在倾听。

sentences.en: They hear us.
sentences.zh: 他们在听我们说话。

sentences.en: They see us.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了我们。

sentences.en: For the first time since I started doing what I was doing, it actually seemed like, wow, wow, I am making a difference.
sentences.zh: 自我开始做这件事以来，第一次，我真的觉得，哇，哇，我正在产生影响。

sentences.en: Somebody is hearing me.
sentences.zh: 有人在听我说话。

sentences.en: Somebody does know about my son.
sentences.zh: 有人确实了解我的儿子。

sentences.en: That's what kind of hit home for me.
sentences.zh: 这就是真正触动我的地方。

sentences.en: This idea has been out there on the far right for a while, that immigrants are, many of them
sentences.zh: 极右翼一直有一种观点认为，许多移民

sentences.en: are dangerous to the American public, that they shouldn't be here, that they're threatening the safety of Americans.
sentences.zh: 对美国公众是危险的，他们不应该留在这里，他们正在威胁美国人的安全。

sentences.en: And these families are kind of the perfect embodiment of that idea.
sentences.zh: 而这些家庭正是这种观点的完美化身。

sentences.en: And so I can't speak to where the president originally got his ideas about immigration, but definitely by the time he met with these families, I think that became emotional and
sentences.zh: 所以我无法得知总统最初是如何形成他对移民的看法的，但毫无疑问，当他与这些家庭会面时，我认为这成为了他所说之话的情感和

sentences.en: human evidence for what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 人性证据。

sentences.en: So looking back on the campaign and now that President Trump is in office, what are the concrete policies that came out of all this work, all this activism with these families?
sentences.zh: 那么回首竞选历程，如今特朗普总统已经上台，所有这些工作以及与这些家庭共同开展的激进主义活动，带来了哪些具体的政策呢？

sentences.en: I think a lot of people talk about how the president hasn't accomplished what he might have
sentences.zh: 我认为很多人都在谈论总统在国会中未能实现他可能

sentences.en: liked to in Congress, but on immigration, he's really pushed ahead with the promises that he made on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 希望的目标，但在移民问题上，他确实大力推进了他在竞选时作出的承诺。

sentences.en: The wall hasn't been built, but the federal government is cracking down on people who are in the country illegally in numbers that are definitely up from where we were last year.
sentences.zh: 边境墙尚未建成，但联邦政府正在严厉打击非法滞留国内的人员，其力度明显高于去年。

sentences.en: They're, in some cases, pushing to criminalize a lot of violations associated with immigrants.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们正推动将与移民相关的许多违规行为定为刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: So while he might not be as far along as he might want to be on some of these other issues,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管他在其中一些其他问题上的进展可能没有他想要的那么远，

sentences.en: I think to his supporters, he can definitely point to a lot of his actions on immigration and say, you know, I'm following through.
sentences.zh: 我认为对他的支持者而言，他绝对可以指出自己在移民问题上的许多行动并说，看吧，我在兑现承诺。

sentences.en: So, Vivian, looking back on what he's been able to do as president, did bringing these families into the fold work for him?
sentences.zh: 那么，薇薇安，回顾他作为总统所取得的成就，将这些对他而言的这些家庭纳入其中是否起作用了？

sentences.en: I'm going to say yes.
sentences.zh: 我要说是的。

sentences.en: I think that what becomes really powerful in politics is when you can kind of reduce it down to its essentials.
sentences.zh: 我认为政治中最有力的事情，就是你能把它简化到最本质的层面。

sentences.en: And Trump's theme throughout his campaign was it's dangerous to have these people here.
sentences.zh: 特朗普整个竞选期间的主题就是，让这些人留在这里很危险。

sentences.en: When Mexico sends its people, they're not sending their beSt.
sentences.zh: 当墨西哥送它的人民来时，他们送来的并不是最好的人。

sentences.en: They're not sending you.
sentences.zh: 他们送来的不是你。

sentences.en: They're not sending you.
sentences.zh: 他们送来的不是你。

sentences.en: They're sending people that have lots of problems, and they're bringing those problems with us.
sentences.zh: 他们送来的是有很多问题的人，他们把这些问题带给了我们。

sentences.en: And these people demonstrated that in a really powerful, in a really emotionally powerful way.
sentences.zh: 而这些人以一种非常强有力、情感极为强烈的方式证明了这一点。

sentences.en: President Trump gave us a venue for us to get our stories out and to tell America what's happening and what happened to our children.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统为我们提供了一个平台，让我们能够说出我们的故事，告诉美国正在发生什么以及我们的孩子身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: And for the first time, I feel like my son didn't die for absolutely no reason whatsoever that this man is going to give my son's death meaning.
sentences.zh: 生平第一次，我觉得我的儿子并非毫无意义地死去，这个人将赋予我儿子的死以意义。

sentences.en: Steve, thank you so much for talking with us, and I'm so sorry for your loss.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，非常感谢你接受我们的采访，对于你的遭遇我深感难过。

sentences.en: Thank you, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，女士。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 今天的《每日新闻》就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Caitlin Dickerson.
sentences.zh: 我是凯特琳·迪肯森。

sentences.en: Michael Barbaro will be back on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴巴罗将在周四回归。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: I'm hoping.
sentences.zh: 我希望。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: Yeah, order to be.
sentences.zh: 对，必须肃静。

sentences.zh: 当选举迎进了一批自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。
